title: SvgForeignObject
responsibility: Renders the native foreignObject element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgForeignObject.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet that supplies the element's child content. It is invoked without arguments when present; when omitted, no child content is rendered.

outputs.name: SvgForeignObject
outputs.description: The component renders a native SVG foreignObject element and spreads every remaining prop onto it. When children is present, its snippet is rendered inside the element; no wrapper element is added.
